metadata.body:
# PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

Blueprint for clio-agent. The numeric work lives in plain scripts in this
repository so it can run on PBS compute nodes without an LLM:

- `agent/manifest.py`: list the DASV records on `s3://nrel-pds-porotomo/` and sample them.
- `agent/detect.py`: per-record detector (common-mode removal, 10-150 Hz band-pass, median STA/LTA).
- `agent/pbs/submit.sh`: submit the distributed detection plus aggregation job to Aurora.
- `agent/hazard.py`: anomaly z-scores, event catalogue, pumping volumes, seismogenic index, probabilities.

The experts orchestrate those scripts, inspect files, and explain results. They
never make up numbers. Every figure they report comes from `summary.json` or a
tool result.

Install by linking this directory into `~/.config/clio-agent/agent-blueprints/`.

File: /home/hyoklee/cae_test_data/porotomo/dasv_native_PoroTomo_iDAS025_160318160317.h5

Layout: native DAS-HDF5-1.0 — flat root, NO subgroups. `hdf5_visit` and `hdf5_list_keys('/')` return the same 8 objects, all Datasets; there are no groups or nested paths.

Every dataset in the file (complete, none omitted):

| dataset path | shape        | dtype   |
|--------------|--------------|---------|
| /channel     | (384,)       | int32   |
| /crs         | () (scalar)  | uint8   |
| /das         | (30000, 384) | float32 |
| /t           | (30000,)     | float64 |
| /trace       | (30000,)     | int64   |
| /x           | (384,)       | float32 |
| /y           | (384,)       | float32 |
| /z           | (384,)       | float32 |

Additional layout details from the same inspection:
- Chunking: /das chunk shape (2000, 384) (~3000 KB); /t chunk shape (30000,) (~234.38 KB).
- Sample rate: /t is epoch-seconds (float64); consecutive deltas are exactly 0.001 s → 1000 Hz. First sample 1458316997.990472 (= 2016-03-18 16:03:17.990 UTC, matching the filename 160318160317); last sample 1458317027.9894722 → ~30 s of data at 30000 samples, 384 channels.
- Semantics (native DAS layout): /das = raw strain traces (samples × channels), /t = time axis, /x,/y,/z = channel positions, /channel = channel indices, /trace = trace numbers, /crs = scalar CRS flag.
- Caveat: root and /das attributes appear to exist but could not be decoded by the tool (bytes/ndarray JSON serialization error on the tool side); no groups exist, so the dataset list above is exhaustive.
- The file was opened read-only and has been closed.
